summary: v12 full-width/bigger-type check, frontend only (Vite app at /app/src). Tested home, hub and Group Maker at 1920, 1440, 1280, 1100 and 800px. No horizontal overflow at any width (scrollWidth == innerWidth). The type and Group Maker grid changes work. Two items FAIL: (1) at 1920 the content is only 81% of the viewport because the CSS actually shipped is min(1560px, 94vw), not min(1800px, 96vw) as described; (2) the home hero does not stack at 800px.

ui_bugs.issue: /app/src/v5.css line 170 sets max-width: min(1560px, 94vw). At 1920 the content is 1560px wide = 81.3% (180px on each side), below the ~90% target. 1440/1280/800 give 94%, which passes. Expected min(1800px, 96vw), which gives about 93.75% at 1920.

At 800px wide .home-hero still has 2 columns (279px + 321px) and h1 is 52px, so the hero does not stack on narrow screens. Add e.g. @media (max-width: 900px) { .home-hero { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 40px } } after the v12 rule; the v12 rule may be overriding an earlier media query.

issues: Row title 28px PASS, page kicker 18px, buttons 14px font and 44px tall PASS. .row-kicker is still 11px uppercase: readable but small; consider 12-13px.
Generate groups button sits right after the size picker and leaves a large empty area on the right of the wide controls card; consider pushing it right or spreading the controls.
Names like 'Student 10'-'Student 19' all show as 'Student 1.' because of the 'First L.' short-name logic, not CSS clipping, so different students look identical. Minor.

passed_checks: No horizontal overflow on home, hub or Group Maker at 1920, 1440, 1280, 1100 and 800
Container width ratio is 94% at 1440, 1280 and 800
Hub class row h2 is 28px; buttons are larger
Group Maker: 5 option cards in one row with equal widths (286px at 1920, 245px at 1440, 215px at 1280)
Group Maker: 2 option cards per row at 1100 and 800 (the 5th card wraps)
Groups grid fills the card width: 5 columns at 1920, 4 at 1440, 3 at 1280, 2 at 800
action_items: Change v5.css line 170 to max-width: min(1800px, 96vw) so content reaches about 94% at 1920
Make .home-hero a single column below about 900px (put the media query after the v12 rule)
Optional: increase .row-kicker to 12-13px; place the GM Generate button so the controls card is not right-empty
